content: Formspree is the no-backend contact form for Next.js: official Next.js guide, @formspree/react 3.0.0 useForm hook, spam filtering, dashboard, Vercel integration via NEXT_PUBLIC_FORM. Resend needs Server Actions and DIY spam/storage. Getform rebranded to Forminit; weaker React DX. WhatsApp is a wa.me link, no library.
